knowledge_gaps: The proposed gBCE positive loss, beta schedule, and positive-to-negative weighting are not derived from the cited method. A normalization mismatch could invalidate the calibration experiment.

Reproduction requires the exact baseline configuration, exclusion policy, eligible-item counting rule, negative-sampling implementation, checkpoint policy, and remaining compute budget. Preserving an unspecified configuration is insufficient.

Training margins do not establish probability calibration. Historical validation differences lack paired uncertainty, and repeated checkpoint selection can exaggerate gains. Missing diagnoses also leave the claimed priority and potential rating provisional.
